author: Animalogic
description:
These animals came back from extinction, kinda. Long believed to be gone forever, these animals were hiding, waiting for the right moment to return, or for a keen eye to find them. Today there are over 70 species known to have been considered extinct, and have since returned. These are the Lazarus species.

Examining the nature of the beast.

From apex predators to the planet's strangest creatures, Animalogic goes deep into the science, behavior, and biology of the animal kingdom, one species at a time.
